title: KF module SDK conformance fixture
description: One case of the shared conformance suite. Every SDK runner (Java by hand, TS/PHP derived) reads every fixture, checks it against this shape, and fails on an unknown area, a failing case or a case it cannot run. There is no skip.

id.description: <area>/<file name without .json>; unique in the suite

area.description: The behaviour the case fixes; equal to the fixture's directory name

description.description: What the case proves, in one or two sentences

source.description: Where the wire shape comes from: a platform class/IT with the platform sha, a section of sdk-protocol.md, or a plan that defines an SDK rule (e.g. "")

input.description: Area-specific input (see README.md, one section per area)
